import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent'})
B62_TXT = """A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3

H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rr=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); hdr=rr[0].split(); B62={}
for r in rr[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for b,v in zip(hdr,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw_affine(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    smat=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm=M[i-1]; px=Ix[i-1]; py=Iy[i-1]
        c=np.stack([pm+go,px+ge,py+go]); Ix[i]=c.max(0); pX[i]=c.argmax(0)
        dg=np.stack([pm[:-1],px[:-1],py[:-1]]); M[i,1:]=dg.max(0)+smat[i-1]; pM[i,1:]=dg.argmax(0)
        Mi=M[i]; Xi=Ix[i]; Yi=Iy[i]; pYi=pY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c0=Mi[j-1]+go; c1=Xi[j-1]+go; c2=Yi[j-1]+ge
            if c0>=c1 and c0>=c2: Yi[j]=c0; pYi[j]=0
            elif c1>=c2: Yi[j]=c1; pYi[j]=1
            else: Yi[j]=c2; pYi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: state=2
        elif j==0: state=1
        if state==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=pM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1; state=int(ns)
        elif state==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append('-'); ns=pX[i,j]; i-=1; state=int(ns)
        else: a1.append('-'); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=pY[i,j]; j-=1; state=int(ns)
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
def map_positions(s1,s2):
    a1,a2=nw_affine(s1,s2); i=j=0; mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1
        if c2!='-': j+=1
        if c1!='-': mp[i]=(c1,c2,(j if c2!='-' else None))
    return mp
def fasta(acc):
    t=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")
    return "".join(t[1:])
SEQ={a:fasta(a) for a in ["Q12432","Q04779","Q59K07","A0A1D8PR21"]}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def chain_atoms(text, chains):
    cols=[]; inloop=False; incat=False; out=defaultdict(list); started=False; idx=None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('loop_'):
            if started: break
            inloop=True; cols=[]; incat=False; continue
        if inloop and s.startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols.append(s.split('.')[1]); incat=True; idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cols)}; continue
        if incat:
            if s.startswith('#') or s.startswith('_') or s.startswith('loop_'):
                if started: break
                incat=False; inloop=False; continue
            p=s.split()
            if len(p)!=len(cols): continue
            started=True
            if p[idx['group_PDB']] not in ('ATOM','HETATM'): continue
            ch=p[idx['auth_asym_id']]
            if ch not in chains or p[idx['type_symbol']]=='H': continue
            comp=p[idx['label_comp_id']]
            if comp not in AA3: continue
            out[ch].append((int(p[idx['auth_seq_id']]),comp,float(p[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(p[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(p[idx['Cartn_z']])))
    return out
def pc(A,B,cut=4.5):
    Ac=np.array([a[2:] for a in A]); Bc=np.array([b[2:] for b in B])
    ra=np.array([a[0] for a in A]); rb=np.array([b[0] for b in B]); best={}
    for i in range(0,len(Ac),2500):
        d=np.sqrt(((Ac[i:i+2500,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
        ii,jj=np.where(d<cut)
        for x,y in zip(ii,jj):
            k=(int(ra[i+x]),int(rb[y])); v=float(d[x,y])
            if k not in best or v<best[k]: best[k]=v
    return best
spec={'8TOF':{'eaf3':['D','E'],'rco1':['F','G']},'8KD2':{'eaf3':['D','F'],'rco1':['E','G']}}
rowsl=[]; resolved={'eaf3':set(),'rco1':set()}
for pid,sp in spec.items():
    txt=S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=240).text
    ch=chain_atoms(txt,set(sp['eaf3']+sp['rco1']))
    for c in sp['eaf3']: resolved['eaf3']|={a[0] for a in ch[c]}
    for c in sp['rco1']: resolved['rco1']|={a[0] for a in ch[c]}
    for ec in sp['eaf3']:
        for rc in sp['rco1']:
            for (x,y),d in pc(ch[ec],ch[rc]).items():
                rowsl.append(dict(pdb=pid,eaf3_chain=ec,rco1_chain=rc,eaf3_pos=x,rco1_pos=y,dist=round(d,2)))
cont=pd.DataFrame(rowsl)
mpE=map_positions(SEQ['Q12432'],SEQ['Q59K07']); mpR=map_positions(SEQ['Q04779'],SEQ['A0A1D8PR21'])
def cls(a,b):
    if b in (None,'-'): return 'lost (gap)'
    if a==b: return 'identical'
    s=sc(a,b); return 'conservative' if s>0 else ('neutral sub' if s==0 else 'non-conservative')
def build(df,poscol,seq,mp):
    t=df.groupby(poscol).agg(min_dist=('dist','min'),n_atom_pairs=('dist','size'),
        n_copies=('eaf3_chain','size'),pdbs=('pdb',lambda s:",".join(sorted(set(s))))).reset_index()
    t['Sc_aa']=[seq[p-1] for p in t[poscol]]
    t['Ca_aa']=[mp[p][1] for p in t[poscol]]
    t['Ca_pos']=[mp[p][2] for p in t[poscol]]
    t['status']=[cls(r.Sc_aa,r.Ca_aa) for r in t.itertuples()]
    t['blosum62']=[sc(r.Sc_aa,r.Ca_aa) if r.Ca_aa!='-' else np.nan for r in t.itertuples()]
    return t.sort_values(poscol)
E=build(cont,'eaf3_pos',SEQ['Q12432'],mpE); R=build(cont,'rco1_pos',SEQ['Q04779'],mpR)
def dom_r(p):
    if 262<=p<=307: return 'PHD1'
    if 416<=p<=470: return 'PHD2'
    if 308<=p<=415: return 'inter-PHD / SID region'
    return 'other'
R['Sc_domain']=[dom_r(p) for p in R.rco1_pos]
E['Sc_domain']=np.where(E.eaf3_pos>=216,'MRG domain (216-399)',np.where(E.eaf3_pos<=113,'chromodomain','linker'))
E.to_csv('eaf3_interface_conservation.csv',index=False); R.to_csv('rco1_interface_conservation.csv',index=False)
cont.to_csv('eaf3_rco1_contact_pairs.csv',index=False)

print("FULL Rco1 interface table (ScRco1 -> CaRco1 A0A1D8PR21):")
print(R.to_string(index=False))
print("\nRco1 interface by Sc domain:")
print(pd.crosstab(R.Sc_domain,R.status))

# ---- enrichment statistics: interface vs structurally resolved non-interface ----
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
def stat(mp, resolved_set, iface_set, label):
    res=[p for p in sorted(resolved_set) if p in mp]
    ifc=[p for p in res if p in iface_set]; non=[p for p in res if p not in iface_set]
    def idc(ps): 
        a=[(mp[p][0],mp[p][1]) for p in ps if mp[p][1]!='-']
        return sum(1 for x,y in a if x==y), len(a)
    i1,n1=idc(ifc); i0,n0=idc(non)
    orr,pv=fisher_exact([[i1,n1-i1],[i0,n0-i0]])
    print(f"{label}: interface {i1}/{n1} = {100*i1/n1:.1f}% identical; resolved non-interface {i0}/{n0} = {100*i0/n0:.1f}%; OR={orr:.2f}, Fisher p={pv:.3g}")
    return (i1,n1,i0,n0,orr,pv)
sE=stat(mpE,resolved['eaf3'],set(E.eaf3_pos),'Eaf3 (structurally resolved residues)')
sR=stat(mpR,resolved['rco1'],set(R.rco1_pos),'Rco1 (structurally resolved residues)')

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7))
colors={'identical':'#2b6a4d','conservative':'#7bb6a1','neutral sub':'#d9c47a','non-conservative':'#c0603b','lost (gap)':'#7a2f2f'}
for ax,(tab,poscol,seq,title,dom) in zip(axes,[(E,'eaf3_pos',SEQ['Q12432'],'ScEaf3 residues contacting Rco1 (PDB 8TOF, 8KD2; heavy atoms <4.5 A)',(216,399)),
                                               (R,'rco1_pos',SEQ['Q04779'],'ScRco1 residues contacting Eaf3 (PDB 8TOF, 8KD2; heavy atoms <4.5 A)',None)]):
    ax.axhspan(0,1,color='#f2f2f2')
    for r in tab.itertuples():
        ax.vlines(getattr(r,poscol),0,1,color=colors[r.status],lw=2.4)
    ax.set_xlim(0,len(seq)+5); ax.set_ylim(0,1.35); ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_title(title,fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel('S. cerevisiae residue number')
if True:
    axes[0].annotate('MRG domain 216-399',xy=(216,1.12),xytext=(216,1.12),fontsize=8)
    axes[0].plot([216,399],[1.05,1.05],color='k',lw=3)
    axes[1].plot([262,307],[1.05,1.05],color='k',lw=3); axes[1].annotate('PHD1',xy=(262,1.12),fontsize=8)
    axes[1].plot([416,470],[1.05,1.05],color='k',lw=3); axes[1].annotate('PHD2',xy=(416,1.12),fontsize=8)
    axes[1].plot([308,415],[1.05,1.05],color='#888888',lw=3); axes[1].annotate('inter-PHD / SID region',xy=(308,1.12),fontsize=8)
